title: Rise & Fall unit definitions
description: Every unit type in the game. Each card in a player's deck is associated with exactly one unit type (by `id`); playing that card lets the player pick one of that unit's `actions` and perform it with every unit of that type they own.

id.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case. Matches the engine's Unit.kind field.

description.description: Flavor/rules text, written from scratch (no reproduced rulebook text).

victoryPoints.description: How many victory points a player scores for controlling units of this type on the board, based on how many they currently have.

byBoardCount.description: byBoardCount[i] is the VP score for having exactly i+1 of this unit on the board (1-indexed: index 0 = 1 unit, index 1 = 2 units, etc.) — e.g. [1, 2, 3, 4] scores 1 unit as 1pt, 2 units as 2pts, 3 as 3pts, 4 as 4pts. A count of 0 always scores 0. A count beyond the array's length scores the last entry's value (uses the highest defined tier). Empty until the real scoring curve is decided.

supply.description: How many pieces of this unit type exist in the box, i.e. the hard cap a player can have in play at once.

byPlayerCount.description: Total supply of this unit, keyed by player count as a string.

isMobile.description: False for static units such as settlements — they occupy a tile but never move.

terrains.description: Terrain type ids (see terrain.json) this unit is allowed to move onto. Empty for immobile units.

canCrossCliffs.description: Whether this unit can cross a cliff edge — an edge between tiles that otherwise blocks movement/adjacency for every other unit.

moveDistance.description: Max hexes this unit can move in a single move action, or "unlimited" for a unit with no distance cap (e.g. Ship — bounded instead by its connected region of terrain it can move onto, since it can never leave that region regardless of distance). Optional, only set once decided for a given unit.

blockedByUnits.description: Which units this unit's movement path is blocked by (i.e. cannot move through their hexes): 'none', only 'enemy' units, or 'all' units regardless of owner. Optional, only set once decided for a given unit.

canEndMoveOnUnitTypes.description: Unit type ids this unit is allowed to end its movement on top of (sharing a hex with), as an exception to the normal rule that a move must end on an unoccupied hex. Optional, only set once decided for a given unit.

actions.description: The actions this unit's card can trigger. Exactly one is chosen each time the card is played, and it applies simultaneously to every unit of this type the playing player controls — including 'move' (present on every mobile unit kind), a normal action like any other where each acting unit moves to its own target hex per movement.* above.

id.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case. Matches the engine's PlayCardAction resolution once implemented.

description.description: What the action does, written from scratch.

effect.description: Free-form parameters for this action (e.g. move distance, resource yield). Shape is intentionally open until the rules are finalized — fill in whatever fields make sense per action.
